evidence: The paper uses random forests for predictive modeling but explicitly measures feature importance via permutation-based methods: "The importance of each marker was estimated on permutation-basis using the varImp function from caret." Features are selected using GWAS p-values ("The 200 SNPs with the lowest P-value were then used as the predictors"), not impurity-based importance. No mention of impurity, Gini, MDI, or variance importance appears in the text.
